title: %base64Decode — Decode a Base64 string
purpose: Decode Base64 text back into its original UTF-8 string.
notes: Standard and URL-safe alphabets are both accepted (+/ or -_).
Input that is not valid Base64 decodes to ~ (null) rather than raising an error.

avoid.why: a value that is not valid Base64 decodes to ~, not the original text
